prompt: In the Monty Hall problem, you pick one of three doors, the host opens a different door revealing a goat, and offers a switch. What should you do?

options.text: Switch, it wins 2/3 of the time
Stay, it wins 2/3 of the time

explanation: Your first pick is right 1/3 of the time, so the other two doors together hold 2/3. The host always opens a goat door, which concentrates that entire 2/3 on the single remaining door, so switching wins twice as often.
